text: The product quality is exceptional, exceeded all my expectations! Shipping was also super fast.

analysis.summary: Customer praises exceptional product quality and fast delivery.
analysis.recommended_action: Thank customer and highlight feedback in product testimonials.

text: Customer support took three days to respond to my ticket. Very frustrating experience.

analysis.summary: Customer waited three days for support response and was frustrated.

aspects.name: support
aspects.evidence: Customer support took three days to respond

analysis.recommended_action: Audit support ticket queues and reach out with an apology.

text: The new dashboard UI is intuitive and easy to navigate, but the subscription pricing feels a bit high.

analysis.summary: Customer likes the new dashboard UI but considers pricing too high.

aspects.name: usability
aspects.evidence: dashboard UI is intuitive and easy to navigate

analysis.recommended_action: Offer annual discount or tier comparison to customer.

text: Delivery was delayed by a week, and the package arrived damaged. Please refund.

analysis.summary: Delivery delayed a week and arrived damaged with refund requested.

aspects.name: delivery
aspects.evidence: Delivery was delayed by a week

analysis.recommended_action: Immediately process refund and initiate carrier damage claim.

text: Great app overall, simple usability and helps our team daily. Keep up the good work!

analysis.summary: Customer finds app highly usable and valuable for daily team workflows.

aspects.name: usability
aspects.evidence: simple usability and helps our team daily

analysis.recommended_action: Request app store or G2 review from customer.
